python3 -c "
import trimesh, numpy as np, math
w=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
print('verts', len(w.vertices), len(b.vertices))
# slice at z=7: which triangles cross; get 2D segments
def slice_polys(mesh, z):
    T=mesh.triangles  # (n,3,3)
    segs=[]
    for t in T:
        pts=[]
        for i in range(3):
            p0=t[i]; p1=t[(i+1)%3]
            if (p0[2]-z)*(p1[2]-z)<0:
                a=(z-p0[2])/(p1[2]-p0[2])
                pts.append(p0+a*(p1-p0))
        if len(pts)==2:
            segs.append(pts)
    return np.array(segs)
sw=slice_polys(w,7); sb=slice_polys(b,7)
print('wheel segs', len(sw), 'base segs', len(sb))
print('wheel seg x range', sw[:,:,0].min(), sw[:,:,0].max())
print('base segs near pawl x>20:', (sb[:,:,0].max(axis=1)>20).sum())
sel=sb[(sb[:,:,0].mean(axis=1)>20)]
print('count', len(sel))
if len(sel): print(sel[:10])
"
